nodes.label: person:admin: What do you check before you use it? Lumen: Wood dust and debris can affect …
nodes.text: person:admin: What do you check before you use it? Lumen: Wood dust and debris can affect performance - Is it in good condition? The wood** - What's the grain direction? This affects how the tool will cut - Is the wood dry or green? Moisture content matters for cutting behavior - What's the thickness? The person using it** - Am I properly positioned? The sequence** - Do I need to sharpen first? A dull tool is dangerous - Should I be wearing appropriate protection? Do you have a particular ritual before you start work?

nodes.label: person:admin: How do you keep it in good shape at the end of the day? Lumen: At the end of…
nodes.text: person:admin: How do you keep it in good shape at the end of the day? Lumen: At the end of the day, I help people keep their tools in good shape through a few simple practices: **1. Cleaning** - Wipe down each tool with a clean cloth to remove wood dust - Pay special attention to crevices where debris can hide - A damp cloth works well for most tools **2. Drying** - Ensure tools are completely dry before storage - Wood handles should never stay damp - this can cause cracking **3. Do you have a particular ritual for tool care?
